title: Shared Blind Spots: Which Questions Do ALL Models Get Wrong Together?

original_idea.body: Isolate items every model fails; code them into a taxonomy of universal blind spots.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Strong chain: a taxonomy of universal blind spots is worst-case-for-redundancy, actionable for monitoring.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Accessible: run models, isolate joint failures, code categories.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Tightly scoped: isolate 100%-fail items and produce a taxonomy.

low_compute.reasoning: GPU-light, small models plus manual coding.

novelty.reasoning: Joint-failure-set characterization extends correlated-errors work; partly open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Correlated errors known; universal-blind-spot taxonomy partly open.
